query:
SELECT match_events.id,
             match_events.session_id AS match_id,
             match_events.session_id,
             match_events.side,
             match_events.team,
             match_events.event_type,
             match_events.minute,
             match_events.opponent_label,
             NULL AS detail,
             match_events.logged_by_user_id,
             match_events.manually_adjusted,
             match_events.client_request_id,
             match_events.period,
             match_events.match_elapsed_ms,
             match_events.lifecycle_status,
             match_events.projection_revision,
             match_events.created_at,
             match_events.updated_at
      FROM match_events
      WHERE match_events.session_id IS NOT NULL
        AND match_events.event_type <> 'injury'
        AND auth.parameter('two_sided_live_logging') = 'true'
        AND match_events.session_id IN (
          SELECT match_session_participants.session_id
          FROM match_session_participants
          WHERE match_session_participants.team_id = auth.parameter('team_id')
            AND match_session_participants.team_id IN (
              SELECT team_members.team_id
              FROM team_members
              WHERE team_members.user_id = auth.parameter('user_id')
            )
        )
        AND match_events.match_id IN (
          SELECT matches.id
          FROM matches
          WHERE matches.shared_match_id = match_events.session_id
            AND matches.is_home IN (
              SELECT CASE match_session_participants.side
                       WHEN 'home' THEN false ELSE true END
              FROM match_session_participants
              WHERE match_session_participants.session_id = match_events.session_id
                AND match_session_participants.team_id = auth.parameter('team_id')
                AND match_session_participants.team_id IN (
                  SELECT team_members.team_id
                  FROM team_members
                  WHERE team_members.user_id = auth.parameter('user_id')
                )
            )
        )
